 Most recent Most popular 'Coventry need to stick together' published at 16:26 GMT 16:26 GMT 
 Coventry 3-1 Sunderland 
 Ellen White 
Former England striker on Final Score 
 There's 25 minutes left and anything can happen. Sunderland have made some changes. 
 Enzo Le Fee's goal should give them some momentum now. Coventry need to stick together, they can't lose this now.

 SUBSTITUTIONS published at 16:26 GMT 16:26 GMT 
 Bournemouth 1-0 Leeds 
 Daniel Farke has seen enough as Sean Longstaff, Lukas Nmecha and Anton Stach replace Dan James, Gabriel Gudmundsson and Ao Tanaka.

 Post published at 16:26 GMT 16:26 GMT 
 Man City 0-1 Brighton 
 Chris Sutton 
Former Blackburn striker on BBC Radio 5 Live 
 Jaouen Hadjam has a big job in that left-back position. Olivier Boscagli struggled to contain Iliman Ndiaye.
 3 0 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 SUBSTITUTION published at 16:25 GMT 16:25 GMT 
 Man City 0-1 Brighton 
 Some changes to report.
 For City, Enzo Fernandez is replaced by Nico O'Reilly.
 For Brighton, Mats Wieffer and Jaouen Hadjam are on for Chema Andres and Olivier Boscagli.
 4 1 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 CLOSE! published at 16:25 GMT 16:25 GMT 
 Hull City 1-1 Ipswich Town 
 Ipswich only half-clear a ball into the box and Lewie Coyle strikes it hard and low at goal. With goalkeeper Christian Walton not moving, the ball zips wide of the far post.

 Michael Kayode is shown a yellow card for arguing with the referee about a decision.

 Post published at 16:24 GMT 16:24 GMT 
 Bournemouth 1-0 Leeds 
 Marcus Tavernier has a pop at goal from the free-kick but James Trafford is there to palm it clear.

 GOAL - Coventry 3-1 Sunderland published at 16:24 GMT 16:24 GMT 
 Enzo Le Fee (67 mins, pen) 
 Sunderland cut the deficit to two as Enzo Le Fee sends Carl Rushworth the wrong way with a really nice penalty.
 Just over 20 minutes for Sunderland to pull off an incredible comeback.
 Surely not?
 207 247 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 16:23 GMT 16:23 GMT 
 Brentford 1-0 Nottm Forest 
 Igor Thiago might not be scoring many for Brentford, but he's at least kept one out for the Bees there as he heads away an effort on the goal-line. 
 58 55 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 PENALTY - SUNDERLAND published at 16:22 GMT 16:22 GMT 
 Coventry 3-0 Sunderland 
 Simon Hooper has a good old look at it and deems that Luke O'Nein's shot is struck on the arm of Ethan Pinnock.

 Bournemouth 1-0 Leeds 
 Leeds captain Ethan Ampadu has his name taken for a trip on Evanilson just outside the box.

 Post published at 16:22 GMT 16:22 GMT 
 Coventry 3-0 Sunderland 
 Simon Hooper finally gets a look at the hand ball incident. He's taking his time over it.

 Post published at 16:22 GMT 16:22 GMT 
 Bournemouth 1-0 Leeds 
 Rayan is often praised for his attacking talents but he doesn't half graft for his side. 
 He gets back, puts the challenge in and wins his side a goal-kick.

 Coventry 3-0 Sunderland 
 What is going on here?
 The VAR are checking for a possible offside but they have sent the referee to the monitor already.
 The picture is frozen on the possible offside.

 SUBSTITUTION published at 16:21 GMT 16:21 GMT 
 Brentford 1-0 Nottm Forest 
 More changes for Nottingham Forest.
 Chris Wood replaces Liam Delap, while Arnaud Kalimuendo comes on for Dan Ndoye.

 Post published at 16:21 GMT 16:21 GMT 
 Hull City 1-1 Ipswich Town 
 Hull spring a four-on-two counter attack, but Leif Davis does well to make a vital sliding challenge. Hull suddenly fancy this one.

 CLOSE! published at 16:21 GMT 16:21 GMT 
 Man City 0-1 Brighton 
 Another dangerous ball into the box and this time Erling Haaland's header is straight at Bart Verburggen.
 City are getting closer.
 188 257 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 16:20 GMT 16:20 GMT 
 Bournemouth 1-0 Leeds 
 Leeds are controlling much of this second half but you'd have to say Bournemouth look pretty comfortable at the back. 
 Maybe they'll look for a chance to counter.

 Scott Brown 
Former Celtic captain on Final Score 
 It's a fantastic ball. Tim Iroegbunam's got about three minutes there to run and pick his spot. 
 He's got too much time to run forward. I did not see this happening.
